description: 5 computer science students and one toothless warrior, ready to win the NASA Space Apps Challenge; each with their own strengths and weaknesses, uniting to build a great project.
summary: A specialized monitor designed to detect cardiac issues through ventricular variations, providing targeted solutions for the needs of astronauts in space. The tool also features a mood-tracking log and bone loss monitoring. One of the primary challenges encountered during its development was strict database restrictions and the importance of this project it is to help the astronauts with the few resources.
details: It is a tool that uses data from an internal database provided by NASA to warn of potential issues regarding the heart's adaptation to different environments. It helps prevent and address cardiological problems. React was used for the frontend, JavaScript for the backend, and SQLite as the database. The inspiration behind this project stems from astronauts' need to monitor cardiovascular issues, as it is one of the top 5 most common problems they face without professional medical tools.
